issues.description: Clarified that sous-vide chicken must be fully cooked and ready to eat, and removed fryer oil from the pan-searing ingredient list. Text review covered the final zh-TW, en, ja, and ko article bodies. Recipe-specific cook time, yield, and sensory results still need an actual kitchen check; no kitchen trial or restaurant provenance is claimed.
issues.suggested_fix: Have a cook prepare the recipe as written, record actual prep and cook time and yield, confirm texture and applicable safe internal temperatures, then update the article before reconsidering indexing.
